exposure: major placenta previa (placental edge reaching or overlapping the internal os)
minor placenta previa (placental edge within 2 cm, not covering the internal os)
outcome: management strategies for placenta previa complications
maternal outcomes (e.g., antepartum and postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, hospital stay, mortality)
perinatal outcomes (e.g., preterm delivery, birth weight, Apgar scores, NICU admission, mortality)
cohort: 61 pregnant women diagnosed with either minor or major placenta previa out of 10,041 deliveries at Dr. S.N. Medical College, Umaid Hospital, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India from May to October 2019
finding: Placenta previa was associated with a high risk of maternal complications, particularly antepartum and postpartum hemorrhage, and adverse perinatal outcomes such as preterm delivery and low birth weight.
birth_weight: Almost half of the babies (49.18%) were born with a birth weight of ≥2.5 kg, and 50.81% were in the low-birth-weight category.
